arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS prepaid_debit_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions whose card is a prepaid debit card, across the full data range.
assumptions: 'Prepaid debit cards' means card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)' exactly, not plain 'Debit'.
Counts all transactions regardless of whether they have a fraud label or an error.
Covers the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
